import novamind_api as nm
D = nm.vars.current_day
lo, hi = D-6, D   # this week's 7 simulated days
print(f"=== current_day={D}, week window days {lo}-{hi} ===")

# 1. Compute by plan this week (ledger ground truth total)
r = nm.query(f"SELECT SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE category='compute' AND day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}")
print(f"\n[1] LEDGER compute this week total = ${-r['rows'][0]['s']:,.0f} ({r['rows'][0]['n']} rows)")

# per-plan active usage this week
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) users, SUM(du.usage_units) u
FROM daily_usage du JOIN subscriptions s ON du.customer_id=s.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE du.day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} GROUP BY s.plan""")
tiercost={'A':0.0003,'B':0.0003,'C':0.012}  # current tiers A=1 B=1 C=4
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    p=row['plan']; c=row['u']*tiercost[p]; tot+=c
    print(f"  Plan {p}: users={row['users']} usage={row['u']:,} compute=${c:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL active-only calc = ${tot:,.0f}")

# mid-week-cancel usage (used compute but not active now) by what tier they'd be
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT SUM(du.usage_units) u, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) n
FROM daily_usage du
WHERE du.day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
AND du.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed')""")
print(f"  mid-week-cancel usage: n={r['rows'][0]['n']} usage={r['rows'][0]['u']:,}")

# 2. New subs by plan this week
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) ap
FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} AND status!='lost'
GROUP BY plan""")
print(f"\n[2] NEW SUBS this week (start_day {lo}-{hi}, subscribed):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  Plan {row['plan']}: {row['n']} new, avg_listed=${row['ap']:.0f}")

# 3. Conversion last 14 days
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT start_day, SUM(CASE WHEN status!='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sub, SUM(CASE WHEN status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost
FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN {D-13} AND {D} GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY start_day""")
print(f"\n[3] CONVERSION BY DAY (last 14d):")
for row in r['rows']:
    tot_l=row['sub']+row['lost']; conv=100*row['sub']/tot_l if tot_l else 0
    print(f"  d{row['start_day']}: sub={row['sub']:5} lost={row['lost']:5} conv={conv:4.0f}%")

# 4. DURABLE BASE (start_day < D-35, still subscribed) = recurring engine
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) ap
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day < {D-35}
GROUP BY s.plan""")
print(f"\n[4] DURABLE BASE (start_day < {D-35}, subscribed):")
durtot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    mo=row['n']*row['ap']; durtot+=mo
    print(f"  Plan {row['plan']}: {row['n']} durables, avg_eff=${row['ap']:.0f}  monthly=${mo:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL durable monthly recurring (listed) = ${durtot:,.0f}  (~${durtot/4.33:,.0f}/wk)")

# 5. Payment buckets this week (ground truth on what subs PAY)
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT CAST(amount/10 AS INT)*10 bucket, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) tot
FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket""")
print(f"\n[5] PAYMENT BUCKETS this week (amount range: count, total):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  ${row['bucket']}-{row['bucket']+9}: {row['n']:5} payments, ${row['tot']:,.0f}")
